name: Hirose Yuzuru
source:
When I entered the academy, I fell in love at first sight with Haruka Aizawa, who was a new teacher at the time.  
Since then, I have continued to harbor feelings of admiration for Haruka for the past year.

He kept his unrequited feelings to himself and surrendered to a peaceful daily life, but after his father remarried, he began to look forward to a new life.

He does not join any clubs, but instead devotes himself to his studies, part-time job, and helping out at home.
Having lost his mother at a young age and with his father being a rather careless person, he has become quite skilled at household chores.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/ntrshimai/chara.html]official site[/url]]
